governance.title: Agent governance
governance.description: .agent/ contains declarative metadata. AGENTS.md files explain ownership, local commands, formatter responsibility, required gates, and the difference between local and remote evidence. The validator rejects credentials, private keys, and executable directives. sibyl init reads manifests without executing project code.

intro.title: SibylHub platform
intro.description: SibylHub connects a server-rendered Astro site, a Laravel registry editor, a Rust API, a workstation CLI, and this static documentation site through versioned shared schemas.

runtime-boundaries.title: Runtime and deployment boundaries
runtime-boundaries.description: The web application uses Astro server output and Wrangler Worker preview/deploy commands. Documentation produces a static build/ directory. The backoffice export writes a local R2-compatible tree before any separate publication step. The Rust API reads a validated versioned export, not Laravel tables. sibyl sync needs an explicit HTTPS endpoint and authorization.

schemas.title: Shared schemas
schemas.description: The optional Context7 retrieval boundary reads these versioned artifacts as documentation context; it does not become a runtime dependency of the applications and never fetches private or remote state during local builds. This keeps documentation retrieval reproducible and lets each consumer validate the same schema-version envelope.

workspace.title: Workspace boundaries
workspace.description: Turborepo caches deterministic build, lint, typecheck, and test outputs using committed lockfiles and declared inputs. Development servers, migrations, deployment, publication, coverage, and cleanup remain uncached because they have process or external-state effects.
